title: Standalone private Synchronizer public testnet
decision: Exclude only documentation that is clearly not a direct dependency of the current Canton public testnet launch.
conditions: The network uses a standalone private Synchronizer rather than the Global Synchronizer.
The launch does not issue Canton Coin or participate in Global Synchronizer reward programs.
Validator operators are permissioned and governance uses independent identities with internal 2-of-3 control.
Core protocol, Daml, Ledger API, Admin API, topology, onboarding, security, monitoring, wallet, custody, and private Synchronizer material remains in scope.

rules.label: Historical release notes
rules.reason: Historical version change logs are not required to design or launch the pinned testnet baseline. Review them when selecting an upgrade or investigating a version-specific incident.

rules.label: Global economics and rewards
rules.reason: The current testnet does not issue Canton Coin or use Global Synchronizer reward and tokenomics programs. Its fee and traffic design uses the project-selected stablecoin model.

rules.label: Super Validator only
rules.reason: The standalone private Synchronizer uses independent operator identities and project governance rather than Global Synchronizer Super Validator infrastructure.

rules.label: Existing Global network service
rules.reason: This existing Global Synchronizer service or discovery material is not a launch dependency for the standalone private Synchronizer testnet.
